ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels occupying the central lobe regions against 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels along the perimeter and median notch.
